releaseNotes:
- Fast Lane now produces default event CG images from the new Manga templates
- Episode and arc review can run an opt-in CLI playthrough against the real script
- Agent completion approval survives an Extension Host crash and settles exactly once
- Outfit inspector can search Fashion Looks without leaving the current character
releaseNotesZh:
- Fast Lane 现在可用新的漫画模板直接产出默认事件 CG
- 集/弧审查可选用 CLI playthrough，对着真实剧本走一遍
- Agent 完成确认在 Extension Host 崩溃后仍能恢复，且只会结算一次
- 服装检查器可直接搜索 Fashion Looks，不用离开当前角色
